calls.video_title: Why Is Reddit Stock Crashing, and is it a Buying Opportunity? | RDDT Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: ~$90 near its 52-week low; forward P/E 9.3 (was over 30 at the start of 2026); DCF fair value figure not legible in captions
calls.thesis: BUY, first tracked Parkevtate RDDT call: he reiterates his buy ranking after a 30%+ post-earnings crash, calling the stock ridiculously cheap even after cutting cash-flow estimates and raising his risk assessment.
calls.base_case: Q3 revenue +53% to $895M, fastest-growing social platform at scale; operating cash flow $364M, nearly double YoY; $3B+ cash and securities war chest.
calls.bull_case: Logged-in-only browsing could eventually force Google/AI answers to pay for traffic or drive users back to Reddit.
calls.bear_case: Login requirement is already shrinking US daily users (50.7M, down from 51.6M YoY) and Q4 guide implies the smallest Q3-to-Q4 sequential gain in years; outcome range now much wider.

calls.thesis: Cheap, fast-growing, profitable; AI data-licensing tailwind.
